entities.summary: Kenyata Allen Johnson is an American former professional basketball player. A 6-foot-11-inch (211 cm), 240 lb (110 kg) center, he played collegiately at Ohio State University. He played in the NBA, the Continental Basketball Association (CBA), and the NBA Development League. He also played in France, in Italy, in Germany with Telekom Baskets Bonn, in Estonia with BC Kalev/Cramo and in Spain with Ford Burgos.
